svg.title: The pull scene (app/godot/scenes/pull.tscn): a season's events, one pull at a time, in graybox

g.text: The pull scene (app/godot/scenes/pull.tscn): a season's events, one pull at a time, in graybox
draws the blended snapshot and hands the run the controls;
which pull comes next is the run's (get_next_round);
no physics or rules: TrackSpace only turns track
coordinates (x down the track, y left, z up) into Godot's
the easy or pro layout's controls
